question: What physical freedoms result from the visualization described in the preceding verses?
premises: The practitioner becomes free from wrinkles and grey hair.
The practitioner becomes devoid of all diseases.
These are presented as resulting conditions.
inference: The practice results in freedom from wrinkles, grey hair, and all diseases.
uncertainties: The grammatical agreement between nominative and accusative forms is uneven in the transmitted text.
plain_english: One becomes freed from wrinkles and grey hair and devoid of all diseases.
